projectDescription: Strautomator is an automation platform for Strava athletes that lets users create rule-based recipes to automatically update, enrich, and organize their activities.
keyFeatures: Rule-based activity automations (rename, describe, tag, gear assignment) triggered on every new Strava activity
50+ condition types including sport type, distance, speed, heart rate, power, location, weather, and music
Dynamic template tags (${tags}) for injecting live data into activity names and descriptions
GearWear component tracking with distance/time thresholds and replacement alerts
Subscribable ICS calendar of Strava activities and club events
AI-generated activity names, poems, and training insights (PRO)
Automatic FTP estimation from power data
Personal records tracking across all sports
Upcoming club events map with weather forecasts
Garmin and Wahoo device integration with ANT+ sensor battery tracking (PRO)
Spotify and Last.fm music integration for track-based conditions and tags
Outbound webhooks to external services on activity match (PRO)
Batch sync to retroactively apply automations to historical activities
Activity history and automation execution debugging tools
Free and PRO subscription tiers (via Paddle or GitHub Sponsors)
publicApiSurface: POST /api/activities/:id/process — Manually trigger automation processing for an activity
GET /api/account — Get account details and preferences
